title: Radar
subtitle: What people say about your brand and your competitors, and what to do about it.
loadFailed: The radar could not be loaded.

upgrade.title: The radar is not in your plan
upgrade.text: Upgrade to see everything people say about your brand, get an alert when something unusual happens and answer from the same place.
upgrade.askOwner: The radar is part of a higher plan. Ask the workspace owner to upgrade.

listen.title: Hear everything
listen.text: Mentions from Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, Google reviews and the news in one stream.

alert.title: Know first
alert.text: An alert when complaints pile up, a big account talks about you or a competitor moves.

act.title: Act right away
act.text: A ready reply or post for every event, sent for approval or answered in the inbox.

noSetup.title: Tell the radar what to listen for
noSetup.text: Add your brand name, your handle and your competitors. The first mentions arrive within a few minutes.
noSetup.askEditor: Nothing is set up yet. An editor of this workspace can set up the radar.

waiting.title: Looking for the first mentions
waiting.text: The first check is running. It usually takes a few minutes; this page updates by itself.
waiting.nothingYet: The last check ({date}) found nothing yet. Check that your brand words are the ones people actually write.

collect.queued: Checking every source now. New mentions appear in a minute or two.

search.title: Quick search
search.placeholder: A word, a product, a hashtag…
search.live: Also search the news right now
search.hint: Searches everything the radar stored in the last {n} days, in every setup.
search.noNews: No news found for this word.
search.nothing: The radar has not stored anything with this word yet. Turn on the news search to look further.

overview.netExplain: Net sentiment is positive minus negative, from −100 to +100. Neutral mentions do not count.
overview.wordsHint: Colour = the mood around the word. Click a word to read the mentions.

empty.open: Nothing unusual right now. The radar tells you as soon as something comes up.
empty.acted: No handled events in this setup yet.

mention.muted: Hidden. It no longer counts in the numbers.
mention.corrected: Label fixed. The radar learns from it.

correct.title: Fix the label
correct.topicHint: A short topic such as “delivery” or “prices”.

mentions.emptyText: No mentions in this period yet.

voice.title: What people say · {n} mentions
voice.noRising: No word is rising this week.

competitors.emptyText: Add up to five competitors in the setup to see who owns the conversation and how people feel about each brand.
competitors.sovHint: % of all mentions in your market
competitors.passionExplain: Left to right: net sentiment. Bottom to top: how strongly people feel (mentions with a clear emotion).

event.notFound: This event does not exist or was deleted.
event.openPost: Open the post that was made
event.hourlyNegative: Negative mentions per hour, last 24 hours
event.noEvidence: No mentions attached to this event.
event.draftPlaceholder: Write the public reply or post…

actions.inbox: Answer each person in the inbox

event.actionsHint: Send for approval creates a post on the networks of these mentions; it is published only after approval. Add to the planner puts it on tomorrow.

done.planner: Added to tomorrow in the planner.
done.inbox: The mentions are in the inbox.

event.thanks: Thanks. The radar uses this to improve its alerts.

setup.viewerNoSetup: Only editors can set up the radar.
setup.newTitle: What should the radar listen for?
setup.name: Name
setup.nameHint: Only for you, to tell setups apart.
setup.keywordsHint: Your name in every spelling people use, your @handle and #hashtags. Press Enter after each one.
setup.keywordsRequired: Add at least one brand word.
setup.requiredHint: Optional. Keeps only mentions that also contain one of these words, for a name with other meanings.
setup.excludedHint: Optional. Mentions with any of these words are ignored (jobs, unrelated meanings…).
setup.wordPlaceholder: Type a word and press Enter
setup.countriesHint: Nothing selected = every country. Many mentions have no country and are always kept.
setup.competitorsHint: Their name and the words people use for them. Needed for share of voice and the comparison.
setup.competitorWords: Their words (optional, the name is used otherwise)

sourceHints.owned: Comments and messages on your connected accounts.
sourceHints.instagram: Public posts with your hashtags and posts that tag you.
sourceHints.youtube: Videos and comments that mention you.
sourceHints.google_business: Reviews of your Google Business Profile.
sourceHints.x: Posts on X. Each post read is paid, up to your monthly cap.

setup.xCap: Posts read from X per month
setup.xCapHint: The radar stops reading X when it reaches this number.
setup.xCapped: The X cap was reached this month. X is read again next month or when you raise the cap.
setup.created: Saved. The radar is looking for the first mentions.
setup.deleteText: “{name}” and all its mentions and events are deleted. This cannot be undone.

home.title: Radar
home.calm: Nothing unusual in what people say about you.
